description_en: Queries the zones supported by Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) in a specified region. To query the zones that are active for purchase, call the DescribeAvailableResource operation
description_zh: 查询指定地域下，云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）支持的可用区。若要查询当前可购买的可用区，请使用"DescribeAvailableResource"接口获取
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-zones --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accept-language en-US --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeZones

parameters.help_en:
The language of the zone names in the response. Valid values:

zh-CN (default): Chinese.
en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置返回后可用区名称的语言，取值：
zh-CN（默认）：中文。
en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Disabled.description_en:
Indicates whether instance creation is supported in the zone. Valid values:

true: Instance creation is not supported.
false: Instance creation is supported
Disabled.description_zh:
当前可用区是否支持创建实例，返回值：
true：不支持。
false：支持

IsRds.description_en: Indicates whether the instance is managed by ApsaraDB RDS. For Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instances, the return value of this parameter is always true
IsRds.description_zh: 是否属于RDS管控，云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例中该参数的返回值固定为true

SwitchNetwork.description_en:
Indicates whether network transition is supported to switch the instance from the classic network to a virtual private cloud (VPC). Valid values:

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
SwitchNetwork.description_zh:
是否支持将实例从经典网络切换为专有网络，返回值：
true：支持。
false：不支持

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID in the region
ZoneId.description_zh: 该地域下的某可用区的ID

ZoneName.description_en: The name of the zone in the region
ZoneName.description_zh: 该地域下的某可用区的名称
